title: Phase 4: POPULATION - Complete Research with Web Sources
description: Weeks 15-20 - Pops living in the world. Research compiled from web sources with detailed implementation.

web_definition.what_is: Pops (short for Population) are the lifeblood of the country. Every combination of profession, culture, religion, and workplace gets its own unique pop.
web_definition.what_exists: Victoria 3 has 15 professions organized into 3 strata. Each profession has different wages, wealth accumulation, and political behavior.
web_definition.how_to_use: Pops work in buildings, earn wages, pay taxes, consume goods. They become radicals or loyalists based on SoL. They drive economy and politics.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Pops are defined by: culture, religion, state, profession, workplace. Each combination is a unique pop group with own SoL and needs.
web_definition.how_to_expand: New professions can be added with unique wage weights, workforce ratios, and political effects.

strata.upper: Capitalists, Aristocrats - high wealth, political power
strata.middle: Officers, Clerks, Artisans, Engineers - skills and services
strata.lower: Workers, Laborers, Peasants, Slaves - manual labor

web_definition.what_is: Each wealth level has defined needs and 'value' that must be spent on goods. Needs represent what pops buy to survive and live.
web_definition.what_exists: Victoria 3 has 14 need categories. Different wealth levels use different needs. Needs are satisfied by various goods.
web_definition.how_to_use: Pops spend on needs each week. Fulfilled needs → higher SoL. Unfulfilled → radicals. Needs scale with wealth.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Needs determined by stratum: lower stratum = basic goods, upper = luxury goods.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Add new need categories or modify goods per need.

need_system.weekly_spending: value determined by wealth level and stratum
need_system.goods_satisfaction: spend amount on any good in category
need_system.partial_fulfillment: SoL scales with amount spent vs needed

web_definition.what_is: Standard of Living (SoL) represents socio-economic status. Affects needs fulfillment, birth/death rates, radicalism, migration.
web_definition.what_exists: SoL 1-99 grouped: Destitute (1-4), Struggling (5-9), Impoverished (10-14), Middling (15-19), Prosperous (20-29), Wealthy (30+).
web_definition.how_to_use: Wealth = base determinant of SoL. Higher SoL = more expensive needs. SoL above expected = job satisfaction. SoL below expected = radicalization.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Base expected SoL by stratum. Any gap causes issues. Minimum expected SoL increases with literacy.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Institutions, laws, and decrees can modify SoL.

sol_effects.on_needs: Higher SoL = larger, more expensive needs
sol_effects.on_politics: Higher SoL = less radicals, more loyalists
sol_effects.on_demographics: Higher SoL = lower birth rate, lower death rate (different rates)

wealth_to_sol.spending: Wealth spent on needs reduces wealth
wealth_to_sol.equilibrium: SoL drifts to stable level where income = expenses

web_definition.what_is: Buildings employ pops. Pops must live in the building's state. Unemployed pops don't earn wages.
web_definition.what_exists: Each building has positions based on level and production method. Workforce ratio determines max employed per pop group.
web_definition.how_to_use: Buildings need workers. Pops seek jobs. Higher wages attract more workers. Unemployment -> lower SoL -> radicals.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Job matching: available positions matched to pop types with required qualifications.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Build more buildings for jobs. Expand existing buildings.

employment_rules.qualifications: Certain professions required for certain buildings
employment_rules.location: Pops must live in building's state

web_definition.what_is: Movement of pops between states. Two types: Intra-market (within market) and Mass migration (between countries).
web_definition.what_exists: Pops migrate to higher SoL states. Mass migration to USA, Brazil, Australia when culture is radical.
web_definition.how_to_use: Migration laws control if/how pops can migrate. Higher migration attraction = more immigrants.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Target state needs 25% higher attraction than origin. Mass migration needs 15%+ cultural turmoil.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Increase SoL, available jobs, lower turmoil. Decrees can boost attraction.

implementation_guide.select_target: must have 25% higher than origin for intra-market
implementation_guide.process_migration: move pop sizes based on attraction difference

web_definition.what_is: Natural growth = birth rate - death rate. Both affected by SoL (demographic transition model).
web_definition.what_exists: High SoL = lower birth AND death rates. But death drops faster → net growth increases until SoL ~15, then declines.
web_definition.how_to_use: Pops grow naturally over time. Growth is faster at mid SoL. Very high SoL = slower growth.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Base rates modified by: SoL, literacy (−10% birth at 100%), health institutions, laws.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Health systems decrease mortality but increase SoL which decreases birth. Net effect varies.

growth_formula.high_sol: Above 25: both rates low and stable

web_definition.what_is: Cultural identity affecting pop behavior, acceptance, happiness, radicalism.
web_definition.what_exists: Each pop has a culture. Cultures have homelands. Culture groups (Germanic, Romance, Slavic).
web_definition.how_to_use: Same culture in homeland = acceptance bonus. Different culture = discrimination.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Laws affect discrimination: Cultural Exclusion, Multiculturalism, National Supremacy.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Mod can add cultures, groups, traits.

web_definition.what_is: Religious identity affecting pop happiness, politics, acceptance.
web_definition.what_exists: Major religions: Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, etc. Each has denominations.
web_definition.how_to_use: Same religion bonus to SoL. Different religion = potential discrimination.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: State religion affects legitimacy. Religious institutions affect politics.

research.religious_unity: Percentage with state religion affects stability

deliverable: Pops living in the world with needs, SoL, migration, growth
